name: VideoCut Skills
description: Video editing automation skill for removing verbal mistakes, silent segments, and filler words from videos. Integrates Whisper for subtitle generation, FFmpeg for video processing, and includes dictionary-based error correction.
author: Ceeon
usageExample: Install: /videocut:安装 (automatically installs dependencies and downloads ~5GB models). Use commands like /videocut:remove-fillers, /videocut:remove-silence
